generic_plane_recipe.formula: On det(L[rows,pivots]) != 0, let T_free=I2 and T_pivots=-L_pivots^(-1)*L_free. Plane q=q_center+N*T*(r,s)^t+(Q52-q_center)*sigma.
generic_plane_recipe.additional_open: The displayed three direction vectors have rank3.

generic_intersection_justification: Universal plane contains the known3+1+1 lifts. The nonzero leading-cubic minor gives a finite plane intersection near the saved beta; its reduced length5 sample yields an upper bound5 on a smaller open by Nakayama. Known generic5 distinct lifts attain the bound.
limitations: No full S61 fiber containment in the three-plane is proved.
No full generic affine fiber upper bound follows.
The center identity is not asserted to be the trace of the three toric lifts without a separate trace calculation.
